digest.component_or_area: development process and governance audit reconciliation
propositions: Six development-process recommendations from the frozen 2026-08-15 audit require evaluation against prior tickets, decisions, and implementation outcomes before work scheduling.

Escaped-defect metadata (detected_by) was already implemented zero-friction and fail-open in evadible-ambitious-canary; coverage is 1.1% and should be expanded at known automated-filer boundaries rather than made mandatory.

Deterministic plan preflight (P1-P11) was established by elfin-floor-gouge and refined by depleted-lethal-brownbear to block only sound mechanical conditions; further extension requires offline replay, false-positive ceilings, and persisted defect data, not a second framework.

Completion-failure classification must be derived from the 351 existing FAIL sidecars with 682 structured findings before schema changes; adding reason codes is warranted only if offline classification proves stable and reliable.

Risk-tiered review enforcement must be deferred pending pilot measurement of signals, defect rates by tier, override frequency, and CI-versus-LLM disagreement; this project has no routine human Gerrit review, so the audit's human-approval requirement is inapplicable.

Proactive debt management already shipped the 720-LOC module warning in Gerrit change 1751; future work should prioritize debt only at intersections of size, complexity, defects, and centrality, not arbitrary quotas.
